title: Mid-States Hoedown Cleveland
summary: Discover the highlights from Massimo’s performance at the Dubuque Theisen’s show: vehicle demos, crowd reactions, and the best off-road models.
body_markdown:
Today, at the bustling Mid-States Hoedown event at the Huntington Convention Center, local off-road innovator Massimo Motor is making waves with its latest lineup of powersports vehicles. The trade show—running through June 26 and hosted by Mid-States Distributing—attracts retailers and enthusiasts from across the nation.
